action.command:
cd /workspace
echo "=== /processes ==="
curl -s http://localhost:8080/processes | /workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
import json,sys
d=json.load(sys.stdin)
procs = d if isinstance(d,list) else d.get('processes',d)
from collections import Counter
st=[p.get('state') for p in procs]
print(Counter(st))
for p in procs:
    if p.get('state') not in ('running',):
        print(f\"  {p.get('name'):28s} state={p.get('state')} last_exit={p.get('last_exit_code')}\")
"
